ZhongXi_NeiXiYan.header: ZhöngXi Néi XiYän | Centre Knne Inner Knee Eye
ZhongXi_NeiXiYan.additionalInfo: In the acute phase, first bloodlet the affected elbow, and then needle Zhong Xi, Nei Xi Yan, St-35 Du Bi. Point Name Zhöng [4] — centre, middle. XT - knee Néi - the inner part of the body. eyes - knee Yän [EN]- eyes The name of the point indicates that it is located on the knee.
